sources.title: Qwen3-ASR Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: 1 Introduction Figure 1: Qwen3-ASR family includes all-in-one ASR models with advantages in multilingual, noisy speech recognition, singing voice recognition and inference efficiency, so as to a novel multilingual speech forced alignment model for predicting timestamps of words or sentences in ASR results.
